stories.title: Deeside Ice Rink’s Christmas sessions had 21,000 attendances last year, and they’re back
stories.summary: Christmas ice skating returns to Deeside Ice Rink in Queensferry on Saturday 21 November, with tickets at £13 per person including skate hire. stories.title: Just 6.7% of transport drivers and operators in Wales are women, figures show
stories.summary: Women make up 20% of Wales’s transport and communications workforce, according to research by Transport for Wales. That falls to 6.7% among transport and mobile machine drivers and operators, with particularly low representation among drivers, engineers and vehicle maintenance staff. stories.title: Halkyn Mountain wildfires raised as climate groups gather at Theatr Clwyd
stories.summary: Clwyd East MP Becky Gittins has pointed to the wildfires on Halkyn Mountain as an example of extreme weather in north Wales, after bringing climate groups together at Theatr Clwyd in Mold. stories.title: New affordable homes in Flintshire almost halve as Wales hits record high
stories.summary: The number of new affordable homes delivered in Flintshire almost halved last year, Welsh Government figures show. The county delivered 110 additional affordable homes between April 2025 and March 2026, down from 213 the year before. Only the Vale of Glamorgan, down 172, recorded a bigger fall in Wales. stories.title: Met Office fog warning issued for Flintshire and Wrexham overnight into Monday
stories.summary: A yellow weather warning for fog has been issued for Flintshire and Wrexham from 6pm on Sunday until 11am on Monday. The Met Office said visibility could fall to around 50 metres or less in some places. The warning also covers Denbighshire, Conwy, Gwynedd, Cheshire West and Chester and Merseyside, along with much of England
